title: ziziphus roxburghii
intro: Ziziphus roxburghii, commonly known as the jujube tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Asia and the Himalayas. The health benefits of Ziziphus roxburghii include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ziziphus roxburghii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, such as ziziphin and betulinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
